Scope back to AWS: drop Lambda from this Task (Jack: "ok great lets continue to focus on aws then"). EC2 on-demand + spot, plus spot for existing providers, remains the scope. Price notes for EC2 templates: g6.xlarge is the reference; consider g4dn.xlarge (T4, $0.53 od / ~$0.23 spot us-west-2) as a cheap option; g6.2xlarge spot was below g6.xlarge spot today, so choose by live price. us-west-2 spot G quota is 32 vCPU.
